sources.title: Hy3 Preview — Tencent Hunyuan 3 Open-Source Model
sources.snippet: Hy3 Preview (also called Hunyuan 3 or Hunyuan 3.0) is the latest open-source large language model developed by the Tencent Hunyuan (Hy) team. It uses a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture with 295B total parameters, activating 21B per inference pass, and supports up to 256K context window.
